# Supplied synthetic proof

Acme lab sample: 8 of 10 bottles stayed below 10°C for 6 hours at 22°C ambient. This is invented test copy for the fixture, not a real product finding. No testimonials or certifications are supplied.

500 ml: 280 g, 22 cm. 750 ml: 360 g, 28 cm. Both use a screw cap and fit a 75 mm holder.
